title: Cheapest Gyms in Palmy
meta_desc: Discover the most affordable gym options in Palmerston North, including no-contract alternatives and the Exercise NZ subsidy programme for eligible members.
intro: Palmerston North has a range of gym options to suit different budgets and preferences. For those on a tight budget, there are several affordable options available. The Exercise NZ subsidy programme offers 40-70% off gym memberships for eligible members.

sections.heading: Most Affordable Options
sections.body: The cheapest gym option in Palmerston North is Snap Fitness, with a competitive pricing structure. However, prices may vary depending on the time of year and promotions available. Contours is another option that offers no-contract memberships, providing flexibility for those who don't want to commit to a long-term contract.
list: Snap Fitness: prices start from around $10/week

sections.heading: No-Contract Alternatives
sections.body: For those who prefer not to commit to a contract, Contours and Les Mills offer no-contract membership options. Les Mills also has a flexi membership with no lock-in contract, providing flexibility for members. Additionally, the Exercise NZ subsidy programme can be used with these no-contract options, further reducing the cost.
list: Les Mills: flexi membership with no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy
sections.body: The Exercise NZ subsidy programme offers 40-70% off gym memberships for eligible members. This can be used in conjunction with the no-contract alternatives, making gym memberships even more affordable. To be eligible, members must be new to the gym or have been inactive for 12+ months.
list: Eligible members: new members or those inactive for 12+ months
